text_block_list.text:
On my way home, I ran into Symboli Rudolf, 
who was heading in the opposite direction 
toward the training course.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Fortunately, the academy is at peace. And 
whenever I have rare free time on my 
hands, it's back to training.
choice_data_list: I just finished training, didn't I?
I just finished training, you know?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Think nothing of it; a little fatigue is 
rather pleasant, even. There is no need 
for concern.
choice_data_list: In that case, I'll join you.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Fufu, I knew you would agree with me!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Well then, let's train for as long as time 
permits today.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Let us aim together for the heights that 
no one else can ever reach!

True to her word, she continued her 
training until the track closed for the 
day.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hoh, wearing yourself out over a minor 
opponent, are you?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"...Those are the words of my Trainer. As 
an Umamusume, I should take them to 
heart."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Understood. I shall head home and rest for 
today.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
If we stumble because our eyes are fixed 
solely on the grand cause, we'll become 
nothing more than a laughingstock.
